original_issue.title: M6.P2 E695/T22: os-scripts-and-launch: the OS's system services and platform quirks
original_issue.body:
Slice T22 of the renovation order: `docs/reviews/order.md` § T22, id `os-system-services` in `docs/reviews/slices.json`. Phase M6.P2, under epic #339 until this area's epic is filed at its first dispatch (then re-parented and retitled `E<epic>/T22`, `milestone-phase-naming.md`). Proposed by the survey (#641); the order is D-WORKFLOW-188 (the fourth version, 2026-10-23). Run under the per-slice procedure of `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` § 6b, from the brief the planner writes before dispatch (§ 7).

## Scope

- **Area:** os-scripts-and-launch; **kind:** read; **lens:** security, brittleness
- **Why here:** busybox's configuration, the systemd units and the per-platform quirks run as root on every device; the inventory reads a whole package as reached, so `system-utils`' per-device sources (`sources/devices/` for AMD64, GENERIC_X64, RK3399, RK3566 and S922X, `sources/autostart/AMD64`) read `shipped` although `package.mk` installs only `${DEVICE}`'s: the slice first derives which the shipped pair (H700, SM8550, which have none) and the VM install, as T29 does for the quirks, reads those line by line, and records the rest as unshipped rows (the coordinator's read of the third version)
- **Paths:** areas `os-scripts-and-launch`; globs `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/sysutils/**`, `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/hardware/**`, `!projects/ROCKNIX/packages/hardware/quirks/devices/**`. 422 paths, 16,604 lines; 10,898 lines read, 3,002 of them fork-own (inventory at `eb4763e3cc`). The exact list is `tools/renovation-inventory --order`'s membership of `os-system-services`.
- **Provenance tiers:** fork-own 24, upstream-carried 398
- **Read before:** none (the renovation gates no release, D-WORKFLOW-187)
- **Review depth:** Extended -- the systemd units and services run as root on every device (security lens; plan § 6c)
- **Interacting subsystems (read-only context):** `os-launch-control-state`'s scripts; `ApiSystem` (`es-state-and-bridge`); the devices' options; the game-end and autostart hooks (`sysutils/autostart`, read here)

reviewed-at:
fixed-at:

**Can this be done on the VM?** Yes, for the units and the GENERIC_X64 quirks; for the rest, no -- and the no is a read plus a `docs/releases/device-facts.md` row, never a device run. The guest runs the 29 units and `platforms/GENERIC_X64/*` (five fork-own files), so a behaviour claim about a unit (enabled, as root, on tty1, the autostart order, `userconfig-setup`'s first boot with seeded files) is proven on one GENERIC_X64 guest, under 30 minutes, in the window the coordinator grants on #669 after the M7 lane's FINAL RETURN and T13's cycle; the H700 and SM8550 platform quirks, `002-device-switch`, `QUIRK_DEVICE`'s device-tree branch, the `sleep.d/` hooks and `volume-fixup.service` are read line by line and point at a device-facts row or stay open items to test. Nothing runs on a handheld; no build, no plan generation, no fetch. The two Phase 4.6 seats are the only `tools/council/run invoke` calls; every other `tools/council/run` call carries `COUNCIL_ENV_FILE=/nonexistent`.

## Acceptance criteria

The brief is `docs/reviews/briefs/os-system-services.md` at version 2 (`cc8b6cf2a3`); these 18 are its § 7, and where the two differ this body wins and the coordinator corrects the brief (D-WORKFLOW-189). Extended Executor: Opus 5.5 at high effort unless the dispatch comment says otherwise. `reviewed-at:` and `fixed-at:` are written above by the executor at hand-back.

- [x] `docs/audits/<date>-epic-m6-os-system-services/` holds `00-running-log.md` and `01-research-notes.md` to `05-punch-list.md`.
- [x] `tools/lint-audit-artifacts docs/audits/<date>-epic-m6-os-system-services/` prints `PASS` (its default `resolution` phase, at close; before stage D the same command with `--phase pre-issue` prints `PASS pre-issue artifacts`), the renovation face included.
- [x] `second-opinions/review-plan.json` records `depth: extended` and two reviewers from two other labs (`gpt` / `openai/gpt-6-astra` / `max`; `gemini-argon` / `google/gemini-4-argon` / `high`); each seat's probe and refutation have a `.provenance.json` beside them whose served model is the seat's, whose verification is PASS and whose `facilitator_version` is named; `packet-manifest.json` lists every packet file with its sha256 and the scan's result; a seat that could not run is a named blocker on #669, never a substitute.
- [x] The slice's punch-list issue has every item at a Phase 7 outcome: resolved with its commit, deferred to a named issue (a `bug`, a Backlog the coordinator files, #346, #740, #797, #997, #1000, T29's #676), or recorded as a design with its sentence; `tools/box-check --issue <N>` 0 fail; the ticked and open counts read back by name.
- [x] `reviewed-at:` and `fixed-at:` in the checklist's header carry the lane's commits; the read is on `8ebaf8daad`'s bytes for the 422 (`git diff --stat 8ebaf8daad <reviewed-at> -- $(cat .qa-scratch/t22/paths.txt)` empty) and nothing under `packages/`, `projects/` or `tools/` changes at stages A to D (`git diff --stat <dispatch tip> <stage-D tip> -- packages projects tools` empty; the dispatch tip is the one the dispatch comment names).
- [x] `01-research-notes.md` § Scope records § 2's block with its output (422 paths, 16,604 lines; read 10,898 / fork-own 3,002 / 24 paths; tier 398 / 24; reach 422; written 422), the language dictionary with the `config` files named as read though not counted, the history (87; 33 fork; 54 upstream) and the upstream delta (44 M; 20 D of which 9 upstream never had, 2 upstream removed, 9 deleted; 42 A and 2 R), or each delta with its command.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` carries a coverage table with exactly one row per path under its own `## Coverage` heading, the path in backticks as the first cell: ``awk '/^## Coverage/{p=1;next} /^## /{p=0} p' 02-forward-audit.md | grep -c -E '^\| `'`` prints `422`.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § The reachability table carries one row per path (422) with *installed on* and *runs on* (H700 / SM8550 / VM / none) and the deciding line (`system-utils/package.mk:14-15,27-34`, `quirks/package.mk:15-18`, `autostart:16-28,31-43`, `002-autostart:6-12`), its counts summing to 422 and naming the 8 install-time rows no shipped image installs and the 213 platform files no shipped unit runs.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § The units carries one row per unit (29): the file, `ExecStart` masked, `User=` present or root, the writable path it reads or runs (or none), the guard (or none), and enabled on which build (`system-utils/package.mk` has no `post_install`: the `enable_service` or preset that enables it, found by `git grep -n -E 'enable_service|preset' 8ebaf8daad -- projects packages config`, quoted, or *enabled by nothing in the tree* with that grep's empty result); `shell.service`, `autostart:71-77` and `:50-54`, `cron.service`, `udevil-mount@.service`, `userconfig-setup` and `video.service` each have their finding or their recorded design with the register searched (`tools/archaeology` quoted).
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § busybox states the effective pin (1.36.1, `package.mk:7`, the http URL at `:11`, upstream's 1.38.0 with its seven patches named as renames of the override's own) and, for each flagged applet (`SUID`, `LOGIN`, `PASSWD`, `SU`, `HTTPD`+`CGI`, `NC`, `UDHCPD`), the caller in the tree (`git grep` quoted) or `none`.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § The upstream delta lists the 44 M with, for every finding on one of them, the file's state at `651150fc88` and whether the finding stands, is narrowed, or is *settled by the next base merge*; the 20 D split 9 never upstream's / 2 upstream removed / 9 deleted; the 42 A and 2 R by name; the two collisions (`99-coredump.conf` against `8bce25b3b7`; the sysctls against `54acd9556f`) each with a design sentence deferred to the coordinator.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § The guest cycle records the window the coordinator granted on #669 (the comment's time), the image by file name and BUILD_ID, each boot proof's line (the units enabled and their identities, tty1, the autostart order, `userconfig-setup`'s first boot), and the guest stopped by its pidfile -- or states *no window granted yet* with the proofs listed and their checkboxes open.
- [x] `02-forward-audit.md` § The runs records every § 5 command with exit, wall time, the figure and *a FAIL would mean ...*; a run that cannot be made is `CANNOT` with its reason, never a pass.
- [x] `00-running-log.md` shows no build, no compiler, no plan generation, no fetch, no handheld, no guest outside the granted window, two `tools/council/run invoke` calls (the seats) and every other `tools/council/run` call with `COUNCIL_ENV_FILE=/nonexistent`, and no write under `/workspace/repos/rocknix*`, another lane's worktree or `/tmp`.
- [x] `04-analysis.md` § Q3 carries the root-and-writable-path findings with their bug decisions and `Already written:` lines; § Q4 the pin table; § Q6 a disposition per unit (the 8, the 213 by platform directory, the 9), removals none; § Second opinion grades every item of both seats (confirmed, narrowed, refuted, new), the decisive ones re-read at their lines.
- [x] Every proof in `02-forward-audit.md` carries a `proved:` cell reading `tree`, `history`, `tool-run`, `fixture`, `guest` or `design`; every punch item carries `question:`; every `bug` passes `tools/box-check --issue N`.
- [x] The retro exists at `docs/retros/<date>-m6-os-system-services.md`, is posted on #669, says what the slice did to the two time-to-play numbers (nothing, or the measured change if a unit on the launch path is named) and what T29 inherits.
- [ ] `tools/register-check`, `tools/work-log-index --check`, `tools/rules-check --quiet`, `tools/forbidden-terms-check` and `.githooks/hooks-test` pass on the branch before its merge (after the coordinator's hand-back merge).

## Never run in this slice

**What never runs in this slice:** anything against a handheld; a guest outside the one window the coordinator grants on #669 (after the M7 lane's FINAL RETURN and T13's cycle); a third `tools/council/run invoke` beyond the two seats, or `--member gemini` in Argon's place; a build, a compiler, a plan generation, a fetch of any kind; any other `tools/council/run` call without `COUNCIL_ENV_FILE=/nonexistent` (`--help` included); an edit to any of the 422 or to anything under `packages/`, `projects/` or `tools/` at stages A to D; a push to any branch but the lane's own; `fork-worktree sync|remove|repair`; an edit to a rule, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, a decided register row or `.github/sessions/saved-session-state-next.md`; a write under `/workspace/repos/rocknix*` or `/tmp` (use `/workspace/tmp/m6-t22/`); a credential-shaped literal written anywhere; `--no-verify`; bare `git stash`; `git worktree remove --force` or `rm -rf` on a worktree or a bare variable path.

Filed by the coordinator lane (D-WORKFLOW-189): a slice issue is a work item, and work items are the coordinator's. The 18 criteria above: the first five are plan § 6b's contract for every slice, the rest this slice's, written by the coordinator in the brief's § 7 and copied here with version 2.
